answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via optical Physical Unclonable Function attestation. Each node bonds a resin cap with random pigment particles over its sensor; verifiers send LED illumination angles and match the signed speckle response to enrolled challenge-response pairs. Because scattering geometry resists cloning, attackers must fabricate separate optical modules per fake identity. Yet dust or scratches on a dune or terrace distort patterns and trigger false rejections.
